title: Towards Clinical AI Fairness: Filling Gaps in the Puzzle

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic scoping review and evidence gap analysis evaluating the frequency, associated medical fields, and data types of gender/sex fairness variables across 272 clinical AI studies.
Systematic scoping review and evidence gap analysis evaluating the frequency, associated medical fields, and data types of race/ethnicity fairness variables in clinical AI literature.
Systematic scoping review and evidence gap analysis identifying the prevalence of age as a bias-inducing variable in retrospective healthcare AI research.
Systematic scoping review and evidence mapping to track the inclusion of socioeconomic status as a relevant fairness variable in clinical AI models.
Systematic scoping review analyzing the presence of skin tone as a bias variable, particularly mapping its use in image-based medical fields like dermatology and radiology.
Systematic scoping review evaluating how frequently geographic location and specific institutes/hospitals are considered as bias-inducing variables in healthcare AI.
Systematic scoping review tracking the frequency of patient health status and comorbidities acting as relevant bias variables in clinical AI fairness studies.
Systematic scoping review documenting the scarcity of individual-specific factors like language literacy as a measured bias target in healthcare AI.
